2609.24862.title: When Tomorrow Becomes Today: Self-Evolving Policies for Agentic Time-Series Forecasting
2609.24862.paper_summary: Agentic time series forecasting concerns systems whose underlying mechanisms evolve, making the relative effectiveness of numerical models, reasoning strategies, and intervention rules inherently time-varying. Consequently, a time series agent must adapt the forecasts it produces and the orchestration policy that determines which components to trust and how to coordinate them. The deployment process naturally provides supervision for this adaptation as forecast horizons elapse and realized targets reveal the effectiveness of earlier decisions. Committing all numerical expert forecasts and candidate agent paths before target observation allows each realized outcome to evaluate the entire alternative set, providing delayed feedback without additional annotation. However, existing time series agents primarily incorporate prior experience through forecast refinement, reflection, or retrieval, without systematically converting realized outcomes into persistent updates to the joint orchestration policy governing later origins. To exploit this delayed feedback systematically, we introduce TimEvolve, a frozen-backbone time series agent that converts each realized outcome into persistent joint updates of expert trust, agent path selection, and intervention strength. A temporally ordered predict, reveal, and update protocol applies this feedback to subsequent forecasts. Experiments across eight Time-MMD domains show that TimEvolve achieves the best average MSE and MAE ranks among fifteen methods and the lowest errors on both metrics in seven domains. These results demonstrate the value of learning forecasting policies from the futures encountered during deployment.
2609.24862.paper_summary_zh: 代理時間序列預測涉及那些基礎機制不斷演變的系統，使得數值模型、推理策略和干預規則的相對有效性本質上是隨時間變化的。<lb/>因此，時間序列代理必須調整其產生的預測以及決定信任哪些組件及如何協調它們的協調政策。<lb/>部署過程自然為這種調整提供了監督，因為預測期限過去，實際目標揭示了早期決策的有效性。<lb/>在目標觀察之前提交所有數值專家預測和候選代理路徑，允許每個實現的結果評估整個替代集，提供延遲反饋而無需額外註釋。<lb/>然而，現有的時間序列代理主要通過預測精煉、反思或檢索來整合先前經驗，而沒有系統地將實現的結果轉換為對後續來源的聯合協調政策的持久更新。<lb/>為了系統性地利用這種延遲反饋，我們引入了TimEvolve，一個冷凍骨幹的時間序列代理，將每個實現的結果轉換為專家信任、代理路徑選擇和干預強度的持久聯合更新。<lb/>一個時間排序的預測、揭示和更新協議將這種反饋應用於後續預測。<lb/>在八個Time-MMD領域的實驗顯示，TimEvolve在十五種方法中實現了最佳的平均MSE和MAE排名，並在七個領域中在這兩個指標上達到了最低誤差。<lb/>這些結果展示了從部署過程中遇到的未來學習預測政策的價值。
